name: plan-change-readback
title: Plan Change Readback
description: Plan change readback that prorates by day (credit, charge today, next bill and date), says a downgrade credit goes to future bills not the card, compares now vs period end, lists lost features, and shows usage over new limits, acknowledged if destructive.

meta.stops: Downgrade deleted data over the limit
meta.summary: Before an upgrade or downgrade, reads back today's charge, credits, the next bill and any usage over the new plan's limits, so nobody is surprised by a charge or lost data.
meta.server: Get the real proration preview from your billing provider and apply limits on the server; require the acknowledgement server-side for destructive downgrades.
catches: Charge today and credit for unused time, prorated by day
Downgrade credit going to future bills rather than the card
Switching now vs at period end, side by side
Features lost on the new plan
Usage over the new plan's limits, with an acknowledgement when excess is removed
limits: Day-based proration is an estimate; your billing provider's numbers are the real ones
Taxes are not included (prices before tax)
Doesn't change the plan itself; onConfirm does
a11y: Section labelled by its title; timing choice is a labelled radiogroup
Gained and lost features are marked with text as well as icons
The arrow between plans has an accessible label
